title: P2.13b2 Bind event-stream subscribers to authenticated sessions
description: Production prerequisite for P2.13c DoD-4/5, discovered by QA and re-measured at HEAD bda564a8. The daemon currently injects one global `control-room-1` eventSubscriberId from daemon-store-dependencies.ts into every command edge. event-resume-mcp-host.test.ts therefore cannot construct a true second-session/foreign-subscriber journey: its second session mint is unused and deleting it leaves the arm green. Deliver a principal-dependent, daemon-owned subscriber grant so a real authenticated session can resume only its own bound durable subscriber and a second real session cannot operate the first session's reader. Preserve the intentional operator-authority fence: a work.write-only session remains insufficient and must still refuse EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED@DAEMON_AUTHORIZATION.
definitionOfDone: A verify-or-block gate records the current fixed global reader injection, the production session ledger writer/reader, exact manifest/lock edges for any workspace dependency, and live ownership before edits.

Production resolves the event subscriber grant from the authenticated session/principal through a daemon-owned mapping; neither payload subscriberId, targetAggregateId, MCP transport session id, nor a fallback constant may select another session's reader.

Two real OPEN operator-pairing sessions are bound to independently distinguishable durable subscriber grants. Each can read/resume its own registered gapped subscriber, while session B attempting session A's subscriber refuses exactly EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_SESSION_MISMATCH at DAEMON_EVENT_STREAM_RESUME and commits no cursor or decision mutation.
A work.write-only session remains refused exactly EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED at DAEMON_AUTHORIZATION, proving the new binding does not weaken operator authority.

The mapping is replay-stable across process restart and session renewal/close semantics fail closed; missing or unreadable binding refuses with the existing AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE provenance rather than using the global reader.
Focused production and real MCP tests execute with nonzero counts; mutation drills prove deleting the principal-dependent lookup makes the actual second-session arm red.
taskRails: Do not accept subscriber authority from command payload, MCP request fields, or a test-only fixture.
Do not weaken the exact operator-capability/session-ledger admission implemented by createEventStreamAccessPort.
Preserve atomic cursor reseat plus durable command receipt and existing stable EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_* code/layer semantics.
Name P2.13c task-4dd05f0c6bc84f3890c794a9cb22bcfb as the consumer and land this prerequisite before its hostile host proof.
